summary: Task 003 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: relocates the existing SamplesSection/SampleManager upload UI from VoiceLabPage's body into the new Samples tabpanel added by task 001's VoiceDetailTabs. Pure relocation -- no prop/behavior changes to SamplesSection, SampleManager, or their upload/play/delete wiring. Adds a new thin composition wrapper (SamplesTab) that leaves an explicit insertion point for task 007's future Upload/Record mode toggle.

files.change: New thin wrapper component: renders a `samples-tab` div containing a comment marking the future Record-mode toggle insertion point, then `<SamplesSection {...props} />`. Props are exactly `SamplesSectionProps` (profiles, onRefresh), unchanged.

Imports SamplesTab and wires it as the Samples tabpanel's `content` in the `detailTabs` array (replacing the placeholder paragraph), passing the same `profiles`/`onRefresh` the page already had in scope. Updated the surrounding placeholder-tabs comment to reflect that Samples is no longer a placeholder (Overview/Variants/Test still are, per tasks 002/004/005).
